set_filter_cycle.name: Set filter cycle
set_filter_cycle.description: Change one schedule in a single verified update. Times use the spa's local clock. A start-only change retains duration; an end sets duration. Equal start/end is unsupported. The other cycle is preserved from a fresh read.

abandon_heating_session.name: Abandon heating-session restoration
abandon_heating_session.description: Forget the session without sending spa commands. Only use to deliberately resolve a conflict: current temperatures and modes stay as they are. Normally use End to restore settings.

confirm.name: I accept leaving current settings unchanged

start_bathing_session.name: Start bathing session
start_bathing_session.description: Activate High and temporarily Ready. Raise High only if below the chosen minimum. Restore the original High target, range and heating policy when the session ends. Restoration waits if HA or the connection is offline.

minimum_temperature_c.name: Minimum bathing temperature (°C)
minimum_temperature_c.description: Higher stored High targets remain unchanged. Fahrenheit spas round this minimum up to the next whole °F.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Specify either duration or end time.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Next local HH:MM or ISO datetime including a UTC offset.

start_heating_session.name: Start heating session
start_heating_session.description: Set a timed heating target, then restore the maintenance setpoint.

target_temperature.name: Target temperature
target_temperature.description: A representable value in the spa's current unit and range.

temperature_unit.name: Temperature unit
temperature_unit.description: Must match the spa's current unit.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Starts immediately. Specify either duration or end time.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Next local HH:MM or ISO datetime including a UTC offset.

cancel_heating_session.name: Cancel heating session
cancel_heating_session.description: Restore the maintenance setpoint. If offline, restoration waits for reconnection.

extend_heating_session.name: Extend heating session
extend_heating_session.description: Adjust an active session's deadline. The default is 30 minutes.

reduce_heating_session.name: Reduce heating session
reduce_heating_session.description: Adjust an active session's deadline. The default is 30 minutes.

init.title: Controls and heating prediction
init.description: Only enable after selecting a verified protocol and stopping competing clients. Commands are verified from observed state. Changing this option does not reconnect.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Uses fresh °C/°F readings. Leave empty to learn from water temperature only. Changing the sensor resets the learned model.
data_description.fallback_heating_rate: Used until five clean heating windows have been learned. An estimate, not a measured heating rate.

abort.already_in_progress: Another setup for this endpoint is already in progress.
abort.already_configured: This host and port are already configured.

reconfigure.title: Change spa connection
reconfigure.description: Keep this entry to preserve entity identity. Validation only listens. direct-rs485-tcp is Direct RS485/TCP - fixed address (experimental): it sends without channel reservation or CTS, even for configuration queries. The spa panel still shares the bus; collisions remain possible. Stop other network clients. Select it only for an explicitly supervised compatibility trial.

data.accept_direct_bus_risk: I accept unarbitrated direct-bus writes and have stopped other network clients

user.title: Connect a Balboa spa
user.description: Stop other network clients. Auto only listens; channel-rs485 negotiates ownership; classic-rs485 uses CTS. bwa-tcp is for an actual Balboa Wi-Fi module, not a raw bridge. direct-rs485-tcp is Direct RS485/TCP - fixed address (experimental): no reservation or CTS, even for configuration queries. The spa panel still shares the bus; collisions remain possible. Explicit risk acceptance is required. Validation only listens and physical controls start disabled.

data.accept_direct_bus_risk: I accept unarbitrated direct-bus writes and have stopped other network clients

error.cannot_connect: No valid Balboa status received. Check the host, port, gateway and competing clients.
error.direct_risk_required: Direct RS485/TCP requires explicit acceptance of shared-bus collision risk. Otherwise select auto (read-only) or a verified arbitrated mode.
